description:
No steady-state two-phase pressure-drop validation exists for TampinesSteamArray / tampines::components::Pipe. Only the transient (Edwards-O'Brien) path is exercised.

Thom (1964) gives two-phase multipliers r2, r3, r4 for boiling water/steam tabulated by pressure; Martinelli & Nelson (1948) covers 0.1 MPa to critical. Both are steam-water-specific and recommended at secondary-loop pressures, unlike the air-water-rooted Lockhart-Martinelli (1949).

Per maintainer direction 2026-08-04, any ported correlation code lands as a MODULE under tampines/src/hem/ or beside TampinesSteamArray in openfoam_algorithms/rhoPimpleFoam/ — not a new crate.

Scope context: crates/tampines-steam-tables/docs/validation-scope-turbine-and-pipe.md section 4.1.
title: V&V: two-phase frictional pressure drop — Thom (1964) / Martinelli-Nelson (1948)

description: Rust port of code_aster's constitutive-law and fracture layer (gitlab.com/codeaster/src, GPL-3.0-or-later, upstream commit b504ea08c2f49575e04644cee2e39a63ea45c16e, 2026-08-03) into outram-park-fork-offbeat/src/rheology/. Plan: docs/code-aster-port-scoping.md. Scope is ~102 kLOC (4% of upstream): bibfor/comport, bibfor/lc, bibfor/fracture, bibfor/comport_prep, mfront, plus the 231-entry Behaviours catalogue. Dual payoff: severe-accident creep rupture (melcor-scoping phase 5) AND fuel-performance cladding laws OFFBEAT lacks. Upstream NOT vendored -- read-only sparse clone at /opt/upstream/codeaster-src. ONLY the src repo may be cloned; validation and data repos are out of scope per DATA_POLICY.md.
title: code_aster constitutive-law port -- 151 mechanical laws into offbeat rheology (GPL-3.0-or-later, EDF)
